caption: The drawing depicts a wooden doll, viewed from the back, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The doll has a brown color overall, with visible wood grain texture accentuating its carved appearance. The figure features two long, thick, twisted braids running down its back, starting from the top of the head. The doll is wearing a knee-length dress with vertical grooves suggesting pleats, and has its arms bent slightly at the elbows, with hands closed into fists. The legs are straight and the feet are clad in simple shoes, both matching in color and texture to the rest of the doll. There is no additional object or background detail; the focus remains solely on the wooden doll.
title: Doll
